failure.body:
- Macsec port update, results into memory corruption
- Macsec profile replace -> enableMacsec -> disableMacsec[ deletes key in macsec_ports ] -> accessing dangling reference data -> memory
   corruption -> crash in macsecmgrd

How to Reproduce ?
- While running sonic-mgmt macsec tests between( Sonic - cEOS ), we seen macsecmgrd crashing.
- Sonic-mgmt tests replacing a macsec profile with new profile while running the test using sonic-db-cli
    Ref : https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/tests/common/macsec/macsec_config_helper.py#L119
- We captured the valgrind logs on macsecmgrd process while running macsec sonic-mgmt tests

is there any macsec test gaps ?
- No, current existing sonic-mgmt tests are able to reproduce the issue

resolution.title: Fixing macsecmgrd memory corruption
resolution.description:
Fixing macsecmgrd memory corruption
- Macsec port update, results into memory corruption
- Macsec profile replace -> enableMacsec -> disableMacsec[ deletes key in macsec_ports ] -> accessing dangling reference data

Fixes : https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-swss/issues/3610

**What I did**
         I am allocating memory after deletion of previous profile.
**Why I did it**
         Macsec profile replace -> enableMacsec -> disableMacsec[ deletes key in macsec_ports ] -> accessing dangling reference data -> memory corruption -> crash in macsecmgrd
**How I verified it**
         After this fix, I am not seeing crashes in macsec docker container
**Details if related**
        Valgrind traces are added in https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-swss/issues/3610
